name: Area-Based Mesh Sampling
definition: A mesh sampling method where the number of sampled points per triangle depends on the triangle area based on a surface density parameter (points per square unit).
summary: Area-Based Mesh Sampling generates points on a mesh surface where the number of points per triangle is determined by the triangle's area and a surface density parameter, differing from KD-Tree Guided Point Cloud Sampling by relying on area-proportional probability rather than spatial proximity constraints.
